window.d1Granularity: datetimeHour; partial endpoint buckets may differ from dashboard rolling24h

mode: One authenticated GraphQL query and one metadata GET only. No D1 SQL/query strings, location payload, mutation, upload or deployment.

userProvidedBaseline.source: Human user report passed through root agent; not independently measured by this subagent
userProvidedBaseline.window: recent24h reported by user, exact endpoints unspecified

graphql.query: query ReadOnlyPublicationUsage($accountTag: string, $start: string, $end: string) { viewer { accounts(filter: {accountTag: $accountTag}) { d1Account: d1AnalyticsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: {datetimeHour_geq: $start, datetimeHour_leq: $end}) { sum {readQueries writeQueries rowsRead rowsWritten} dimensions {databaseId} } workersAccount: workersInvocationsAdaptive(limit: 10000, filter: {datetime_geq: $start, datetime_leq: $end}) {sum {requests errors subrequests} dimensions {scriptName status}} } } }

workerInventory.note: Current script inventory count, not requests usage, plan proof or deployed version count
